notes: SUB-STUDY OF A MASTER PROTOCOL. First page (p1), verbatim: "This study H0P-MC-NP05 (NCT05620576) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". This document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) NP05 to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP, with DPNP disease-state appendix DSA CPMP(3) (p2, p16). Nothing was filled from the master protocol. Deferrals to the master, by page: SoA itself shows only ISA-unique procedures and refers to the CPMP and DSA CPMP(3) SoAs (p12); footnote a (p15) 'Collect in addition to schedule described in Master Protocol CPMP' is bound to Concomitant medication, AE, C-SSRS Since Last Visit, Self-Harm Supplement form, Self-Harm Follow-Up form, NRS for pain, Rescue medication usage reporting and PGI - their content (versions, recall periods, scoring) is not in this document; lab tests: p34 'Master Protocol CPMP describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA' and p28 'Additional details are provided in the Master Protocol CPMP' - so the composition of Hematology, Chemistry, Lipid panel, Urinalysis and HbA1c is not given here (panels holds only the ISA-unique tests); ECG details and QTcF withdrawal criteria (p27); efficacy and safety assessments (p27); objectives/endpoints (p9, p18); eligibility (p21); lifestyle (p22); screen failures (p22); intervention handling, randomization/blinding (p23); concomitant therapy (p24); discontinuation, withdrawal, lost to follow-up (p25, p26); hepatic monitoring (p25); AE/SAE/PC definitions (p28, p36); pregnancy testing beyond screening/V3 (p38); liver safety (p40); statistics (p31). PROTOCOL VERSION: the PDF holds only Amendment (a) (approved 13-Oct-2022; original protocol 25-Aug-2022 is not included). The SoA notes come from this version (p12-15). The Summary of Changes (p4-5) records that the amendment added physical examinations at V5 and V7 and the complete/targeted PE note, removed '…and prior to PK sample collection' from the vital-signs note, and removed '…to physical examinations (described in Master Protocol CPMP)…'; the vital-signs change is cited as evidence in measurements. No conflicts between body and SoA notes found (PE wording differs only in 'V801' vs 'Visit 801' and 'should also be' vs 'will also be'). PAGES CHECKED FROM IMAGE: no page lacks a text layer. p34 (lab-tests table) and p15 (SoA last page) were viewed as images: p34's text layer is not column-merged; the image shows the 'Other Tests' table holds one visible row (LY3857210 concentration) and the rest of that table is redacted (CCI), so further ISA-unique tests may be hidden. p15: the 'Participant Devices' SoA rows are redacted (CCI), and one abbreviation after 'AE = adverse event;' is redacted. ABBREVIATIONS: Appendix 7 list (p44-45) plus abbreviations under the SoA (p15), schema (p11), intervention tables (p10, p23), liver stopping table (p25) and hypersensitivity lab table (p34). The SoA abbreviation line prints 'DPMP = diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain' (recorded as printed; the body uses DPNP). Tokens in SoA activity names not defined in the document: C-SSRS. 'PGI' is defined only as 'patient’s global impression of change' (p15). SoA ROWS THE TEXT DOES NOT DESCRIBE: Participant Devices (rows redacted; p19 mentions devices returned at Visit 801), Placebo response video training (participant) (only the SoA note), Reinforce pain assessment guidelines (SoA note refers to the MoO), Prespecified DPNP medical history (only the SoA note 'Includes diagnosis and symptom onset date.'), Confirm ISA inclusion and exclusion criteria (criteria on p21-22), Rescue medication usage reporting, Hematology, Chemistry, Lipid panel, Urinalysis, HbA1c (deferred to master). Intervention compliance is described on p23 (Section 6.4: direct questioning and counting returned capsules). Inline body definitions (e.g. CKD-EPI p21, ATP p16) are not in the abbreviations list since they are neither in Appendix 7 nor under tables. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
